title: Gradient scrolling in a social feed
slide_intent: Make a repeated transition native to scrolling so viewers can recognize the source within a platform’s conventions.
strategic_value: The green mark and moving gradients can retain Channel 4 attribution inside TikTok-style content.
demonstration: A phone video scrolls from gradient rooms into two creator clips with logo reveals. Its published PNG instead places the phone on a checked table.
practical_value: Compare identity overlays with the platform controls and vertical viewing area.

content_islands.name: Published poster
content_islands.spec: Retain the checked tabletop, food and phone as the source’s contextual still.

content_islands.name: Playable demonstration
content_islands.spec: Show the phone on a plain surface while vertical gradients reveal creator footage and the 4.

reference_purposes.Application: The video demonstrates branded transitions inside a vertical social feed.
reference_purposes.Expression: Green logo reveals and spatial gradients recur over different creator clips.
